issue.title: Move, merge, and split tasks — one destination-shaped family
issue.description: Bryan can move tasks between notes, merge tasks into another task, drawer, or note section, and split bullets out into new linked tasks, from capture (`@a+x @b+y > @c…`), the `merged into` relation label, Obsidian (Ctrl+Shift+T and the Links stage), and `bob task move|merge|split`. All of these share one Rust engine per operation. They never lose content or identity, leave `bob task reconcile` with nothing to do, and explain every consequence before and after they write.
